# HUECONA Conference & Awards

> Houston United in Entertainment (HUECONA) is a two-day conference and awards celebrating excellence in Film, Music, Arts, Fashion, Sports, Culinary and Innovation, July 16–17, 2026 at Blossom Hotel Houston.

HUECONA brings together Hollywood expertise and Houston's diverse cultural scene, expanding opportunities for emerging and established creators across Texas and beyond. The event features panels, screenings, performances, culinary tastings, a fashion showcase, masterclasses, and a star-studded awards ceremony.
